ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution exceeding 95% of total surface area; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized primarily on the distal tips and minor surface disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across the entire visible surface. Distinct high-contrast white pixel clusters are mapped to the extreme distal margins of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 55 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 10% of the fluke's total height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern. A prominent high-amplitude indentation (irregular notch) is located on the inner-left trailing edge. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits more frequent, lower-amplitude saw-tooth variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading edges, tapering into acute points at the lateral extremities where they intersect with the irregular trailing edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) at the lateral tips; the right tip displays a more concentrated circular cluster, while the left tip is more broadly mottled.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct horizontal white linear mark is visible on the inner-left lobe. Multiple faint, unaligned diagonal pixel disruptions are scattered across the central dark region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue void on the trailing edge of the left lobe adjacent to the median notch, indicative of healed physical trauma.
